name: Glycerol Suppositories
mechanism: Osmotic effect + mild irritant - promotes bowel movement
dosing: 1-2 suppositories PR, repeat after 1h if no result
contraindications: Bowel obstruction, acute inflammatory bowel disease; avoid if rectal bleeding of unknown cause
interactions: No clinically significant interactions for rectal use
monitoring: Confirm bowel evacuation and assess for pain or signs of rectal injury
pregnancy: Considered safe for incidental use in pregnancy
sideEffects: Local irritation, abdominal cramps, rare rectal bleeding if mucosa fragile
pharmacokinetics: Local action with onset usually within 15–60 minutes
clinicalPearls: Useful for rapid relief of constipation and for pre-procedural bowel prep; advise moistening prior to insertion
indication: Acute constipation and pre-procedural rectal clearance
